cases.candidate_script:
set -u
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dnssec-cname-chain-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prep || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve 127.0.0.2 5340 ready 2> "$HOME/anchor-peer.err" & peer=$!
trap 'kill "$peer" 2>/dev/null; wait "$peer" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.2 5340 || exit 98
control=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control 127.0.0.2 5340 ok anchor) || exit 98
[[ $control == control-ok ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$control"; exit 98; }
echo control-ok
export PATH="$HOME/pbin" BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5340 BASHDNS_0X20=0
check() { dns query ok.test A -s 127.0.0.2 -t 3000 --validate > "$1.out" 2> "$1.err"; }
export BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/anchor.ds"
if check good1 && [[ $(<good1.out) == 192.0.2.60 ]]; then echo good1=accepted; else echo good1=incorrect; exit 1; fi
export BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/anchor.wrong.ds"
if check wrong; then echo wrong=accepted; exit 1; else echo wrong=rejected; fi
export BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/missing.anchor"
if check missing; then echo missing=accepted; exit 1; else echo missing=rejected; fi
export BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/anchor.ds"
if check good2 && [[ $(<good2.out) == 192.0.2.60 ]]; then echo good2=accepted; else echo good2=incorrect; exit 1; fi
cases.comparison: The valid anchor succeeds before and after; wrong or missing anchor must fail, with no prior trusted state reused.
cases.oracle: Independent BIND delv validates the good root anchor and rejects the wrong anchor before the same-process candidate sequence.
cases.purpose: Switch trust-anchor paths in one shell process without retaining stale trusted keys.
